meta.name: activecampaign
meta.description: ActiveCampaign CRM integration for lead management, deal tracking, and email automation. Use for syncing demo leads, managing clinic sales pipeline, and triggering follow-up sequences.

copy.tagline: 同步销售线索并自动触发跟进邮件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用ActiveCampaign管理客户线索和销售管道。
copy.tagline_en: Sync leads and trigger automated follow-up emails
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use ActiveCampaign to manage leads and sales pipeline.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以管理 ActiveCampaign 中的联系人、交易、标签和自动化流程，例如同步演示线索、更新销售管道阶段、触发邮件序列。
howto.when: 当你要求管理 ActiveCampaign 中的联系人、交易或自动化时触发，例如“添加联系人到列表”或“更新交易阶段”。

say.text: 将联系人 ID 为 123 的标签改为“Demo Requested”。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage contacts, deals, tags, and automations in ActiveCampaign, such as syncing demo leads, updating sales pipeline stages, and triggering email sequences.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to manage ActiveCampaign contacts, deals, or automations, e.g., "add a contact to a list" or "update a deal stage".

say_en.text: Create a new contact in ActiveCampaign with email test@example.com and first name John.
say_en.note: Claude will run the contacts create command.

say_en.text: Add the tag 'Demo Requested' to contact ID 123.
say_en.note: Claude will run the contacts add-tag command.
